milestones.name: Phrase Engine
milestones.goal: Build the chained phrase-slot mechanic, extending DendryNexus card mechanics, with unlock conditions and diegetic acclaim judging

tasks.description: Design phrase-chain data model (subject / response-to-opponent / observed-detail slots) atop DendryNexus card mechanics
tasks.notes: Must split the model into an engine part (built in the Riffle repo, tracked there as 2PH.1 behind the external gate GFLYTPHRASE) and a Flyt part, per the boundary test in docs/adr/0001-riffle-boundary.md. When this lands, tell the Riffle roadmap so it can lift GFLYTPHRASE

tasks.description: Implement phrase-slot selection UI (extends card/hand rendering for chained, non-reversible choices)
Implement unlock-condition resolution (opponent's move + observed events + player history determine available phrase options)
Implement diegetic acclaim judging (no visible score; world-state narrative reveals relative success/failure each attempt)
Design/document round end conditions (fail to match prior acclaim, or fail to construct a coherent attempt)
tasks.notes: Informs 2PE.4's judging logic; can be spec'd in parallel with 2PE.1-2PE.3

tasks.description: Open question: should the phrase engine eventually live in Riffle rather than Flyt's src/engine/?
tasks.notes: Resolved in docs/adr/0001-riffle-boundary.md: Riffle holds game-agnostic mechanism, Flyt holds flyting content; the phrase engine splits across both, line drawn by 2PE.1

milestones.name: Audit
milestones.goal: Establish the actual state of Great Hall's 94 scenes before deciding what to fix

tasks.description: Narrative/tonal coherence read-through of all Great Hall content (merchants, showcase, skalds, warriors decks and hub)
Structural/mechanical cohesion check across the 4 decks (do decks reference or affect each other; does the hub tie them together)
DendryNexus feature-coverage audit against docs/dendrynexus-reference.md (confirm which upstream features are actually exercised by current content)
tasks.notes: Pre-interview check already confirmed clean compile and zero dangling choice/goTo/call targets; this task goes deeper into feature coverage, not just link integrity

tasks.description: Triage audit findings into a fix list (tonal fixes, structural fixes, missing-feature-coverage gaps)
Implement remediation fixes from triage
tasks.notes: Split into 6RM.3 to 6RM.9, one per actionable audit finding from 5AU.2 and 5AU.3. 5AU.1's tonal findings get their own tasks after triage.

tasks.description: Refresh docs/dendrynexus-reference.md's implemented-vs-upstream section and choice-level note to match the current compiler and Riffle (coverage audit F5)

Resolve the showcase's undeclared identifiers: make the go-to-ref demo genuine or retitle it as a placeholder, declare or drop `destination`, and rewrite the conditional-text explanation so it stops being live markup (coverage audit F1, cohesion audit F5)
Decide on and fix the hub's reputation increment on every main_hall arrival so deck rewards and reputation gates mean something (cohesion audit F1)
Give mead a sink: at least one card or gate that spends or needs it beyond merchant_card_mead (cohesion audit F4)
Add wit and courage gated cards to the merchants deck, matching the cross-stat gating the skald and warrior decks already have (cohesion audit F6)
Add at least one deck-to-deck link, either a card that leads into another deck or a tag pool two decks share, so the hall stops being a pure star (cohesion audit F2)
Exercise the compiler-parsed features no content uses, starting with a max-choices hand and a game-over ending (coverage audit F2)
